rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name and ZIP and processed the returns appropriately after explicit confirmation. However, the user requested to cancel only the garden hose item from a pending order and specified not to cancel anything else if single-item cancellation wasn’t possible. The agent proceeded to cancel the entire pending order (#W2575533) without clarifying that only full-order cancellation was possible and without obtaining explicit consent to cancel the whole order. This violates the policy requirement to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. Although the final refund total matches the actions taken, the cancellation action exceeded the user’s authorization, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
